protocol.process_order: Each fresh subprocess reverses which backend is measured first; within each measurement, pair order alternates.

limitations: Each process uses the same fixed fixtures and P3 semantics; process medians vary due to host/runtime state.
Timing wrappers execute only in this analysis process and add instrumentation overhead; component sums are diagnostic, not an exact physical partition.
OpenCL enqueue timing includes clFinish; raw device execution and enqueue are not separately observable without queue profiling.
Driver cache, clocks, thermals, system activity, and GPU-global memory/utilization readings are not controlled.
superseded_accounting_fields: The original OpenCL phase medians and opencl_backend_residual_ms were computed by subtracting overlapping inclusive timers. They are preserved verbatim for provenance and must not be treated as a disjoint partition.
P3/P3b operation and cycle timings and the four-process stability observations are retained unchanged.
redactions: Removed transient load, CPU affinity, frequency snapshots, GPU busy percentage, VRAM-in-use snapshots, PCI bus address, local process IDs, executable paths, and temporary log paths.
Timing observations, shapes, seeds, protocol, hardware model, runtime versions, and device capability limits are preserved.
audit_note: Per-process medians and order are retained in between_process_stability; all original aggregate cost summaries are retained in original_cost_decomposition_as_reported. Repeated copies of per-process baseline/profile objects were omitted to avoid duplicating the same statistical summaries.
